description: This file defines the CookiePartitionKey class used for managing cookie partitioning, including serialization, deserialization, and creation from URLs, network isolation keys, and script contexts within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CookiePartitionKey
classes.description: Represents a key for partitioned cookies, supporting serialization, deserialization, and creation from various sources.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a CookiePartitionKey to a string if possible.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a CookiePartitionKey, indicating if valid.

methods.name: FromURLForTesting
methods.description: Creates a CookiePartitionKey from a URL for testing purposes.

methods.name: FromNetworkIsolationKey
methods.description: Creates a CookiePartitionKey from a NetworkIsolationKey.

methods.name: FromWire
methods.description: Creates a CookiePartitionKey from a SchemefulSite and optional nonce.

methods.name: FromScript
methods.description: Creates a transient CookiePartitionKey indicating it originates from script.

methods.name: FromStorageKeyComponents
methods.description: Creates a CookiePartitionKey from site components and optional nonce.

methods.name: IsSerializeable
methods.description: Checks if the CookiePartitionKey can be serialized.

methods.name: site
methods.description: Returns the site associated with the cookie partition key.

methods.name: from_script
methods.description: Indicates whether the key was created from a script context.

methods.name: nonce
methods.description: Returns the optional nonce associated with the key.
